page.content:
Creator of Star Trek.

How Gene Roddenberry connects

  • Topic: Star Trek — Gene Roddenberry created Star Trek.
  • Series: Star Trek: The Original Series — Roddenberry created The Original Series.
  • Series: Star Trek: The Next Generation — Roddenberry launched The Next Generation as executive producer.

What is Gene Roddenberry?

Gene Roddenberry created Star Trek, selling a wagon-train-to-the-stars pitch that became TOS, then returning as a TNG producer whose Federation idealism still frames the franchise.

Key threads lead to Star Trek, Star Trek: The Original Series and Star Trek: The Next Generation.
